1.consolidated_definition: Una fua, o fua-fuá, es una bruja. Una bruja volantona. “Bruja es palabra de ahora.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: A fua or fua-fuá is a witch, specifically a flying witch. "Witch" is a contemporary term.
